title: myrrhidium athamanthoides
intro: Myrrhidium athamanthoides, commonly known as wormseed or wild marjoram, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrrhidium athamanthoides are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues and relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
